content.short: Webstudio is a no-code platform that enables non-technical builders to create dApps.
content.description: Webstudio delivers a graphic, visual builder with drag-and-drop blocks, using blockchain as the backend for compute, storage, and payments. Its no-code tools and approach streamline the stack, enabling anyone to assemble web3 applications without writing code. By leveraging familiar design patterns from visual builders, the platform lowers entry barriers while providing learning resources and ongoing support. The goal is to empower users to create decentralized applications confidently and independently.
